answer: Sybil resistance is enforced via a Verifiable Delay Function (VDF) attestation for each new agent identity. The computational cost of generating a valid VDF proof, requiring significant, irrecoverable CPU cycles, ensures an attacker incurs strictly negative expected utility for multiple identity creations. At the dawn of network integration, this computational barrier makes Sybil attacks economically prohibitive. The network reaches its Byzantine Fault Tolerance zenith by perpetually shifting the attack horizon, maintaining agent autonomy.
